xrefcode.com / docs / cli / live-resolve

$ xref live resolve

by Alexander Panasenko · xrefcode.com
On this page
  1. Usage
  2. Arguments and options
  3. Examples
  4. Static to runtime
  5. Reading the output
  6. Limits
  7. Provenance

Translate addresses between the binary on disk and a running process: a static address (as printed by every static command) becomes the runtime address in this process, and a runtime address (from a debugger, a crash log, perf) becomes the static one. The translation uses the verified PIE slide and the PT_LOAD segments.

Usage

xref live resolve [OPTIONS] --pid <PID> <ADDR>...

Arguments and options

Arguments

<ADDR>...
Static or live runtime addresses (0x... hex or decimal).

Options

--pid <PID>
Target process ID (must be non-zero).
--force-bin
Continue even if --bin does not match /proc/<pid>/exe.
--json
Emit structured schema_version: 1 JSON output.

Examples

The target is ripgrep 14.1.1 (rg) filtering an endless input stream, as on live maps. PIDs and runtime addresses belong to that run.

Static to runtime

0x10b0c0 is one of ripgrep's hottest functions in the profile:

Command
$ xref -b rg live resolve --pid 4084848 0x10b0c0
Output
pid 4084848  starttime 1480887835  match verified_sha256  pie_slide +0x75a99f000000  alive true  changed false
0x10b0c0  static_to_runtime  static 0x10b0c0  runtime 0x75a99f10b0c0  file 0x10b0c0  sym -  /srv/xref-docs/rg+0x10b0c0

Reading the output

  • After the identity header, one line per address: the direction (static_to_runtime or runtime_to_static), both addresses, the file offset, the symbol if the binary has one, and module+offset.

Limits

  • Addresses outside the executable's mappings (shared libraries, heap) have no static counterpart and are reported as such.

Provenance

Recorded with a development build of xref after 0.4.0 on Linux x86-64, on rg = ripgrep 14.1.1 (official stripped release). Live examples ran against one ripgrep process filtering an endless input stream; commands shown with sudo ran as root. Output is unchanged except that whitespace at the end of each line and empty lines at the end of the output are removed; long outputs are cut where marked.
